nodes.description: DSToken public key: the reward token contract instance used by KeyRewardPool.
uint public rewardStartTime: timestamp when reward accrual begins.
uint constant public yearlyRewardPercentage = 10, percentage of remaining tokens released per year.
uint public totalRewardThisYear: computed reward for the current year.
uint public collectedTokens: amount of tokens already withdrawn by the withdrawer.
address public withdrawer: privileged address allowed to collect tokens.
address public owner: administrative address controlling configuration functions.
bool public paused: circuit breaker guarding collectToken.
Constructor: validates and initialises rewardStartTime, key, withdrawer, owner and paused.
public notPaused onlyWithdrawer collectToken(): computes and transfers the withdrawable reward to withdrawer.
public constant yearFor(uint timestamp): returns the elapsed years since rewardStartTime.
public constant time(): returns now (block.timestamp); overridable for testing.
public onlyOwner setWithdrawer(address): updates the privileged withdrawer address.
public onlyOwner setOwner(address): transfers contract ownership.
public onlyOwner pauseCollectToken(): sets paused = true.
public onlyOwner resumeCollectToken(): sets paused = false.
public onlyWithdrawer transferTokens(address dst, uint wad, address _token): rescues mistakenly sent ERC20 tokens.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, withdrawer and authorization checks.
block.timestamp (now): miner-influenceable time source driving reward calculation.
tx.origin: implicitly considered untrusted origin; not used for authorization in this contract.
External call _key.transfer(withdrawer, canExtract) inside collectToken; potential re-entrancy vector.
External call token.transfer(dst, wad) in transferTokens on an arbitrary ERC20 contract.
Arithmetic block in collectToken: add/mul/div/sub over reward math; overflow/rounding sensitive.
Arithmetic sub(timestamp, rewardStartTime) / (365 days) inside yearFor.
Local _time = time() cached inside collectToken.
Local _key = key, in-memory copy of the reward token reference.
Local balance = _key.balanceOf(address(this)) used to cap withdrawal.
Local total = collectedTokens + balance, cumulative token pool.
Local remainingTokens iteratively reduced by the yearly reward percentage.
Local yearCount = yearFor(_time), number of compounding iterations.
Loop counter i in the reward compounding loop.
Local canExtractThisYear: linearly accrued portion of this year's reward.
Local canExtract: final amount passed to _key.transfer.
Parameter timestamp of yearFor(uint timestamp).
Parameter _withdrawer of setWithdrawer(address _withdrawer).
Parameter _owner of setOwner(address _owner).
Parameter dst (recipient) of transferTokens.
Parameter wad (amount) of transferTokens.
Parameter _token (ERC20 address) of transferTokens.
Constructor parameter _rewardStartTime.
Constructor parameter _key (token address).
Constructor parameter _withdrawer (privileged address).

edges.reason: State variable key is copied into the in-memory local _key for cheaper repeated access.
Local _key is the target of the external transfer call in collectToken.
Stored withdrawer address is the recipient of the external transfer, tying privileged state to the external call.
Locally computed canExtract is the value passed into the external transfer call.
collectToken controls execution of the external _key.transfer call before returning.
collectedTokens state is read/written around the external call, the classic re-entrancy window.
balance caps the final canExtract value.
total participates in the canExtract computation.
remainingTokens feeds (total - remainingTokens) in the canExtract formula.
canExtractThisYear is added into canExtract.
collectedTokens is subtracted from canExtract to avoid double withdrawal.
totalRewardThisYear is scaled by elapsed time to obtain canExtractThisYear.
yearlyRewardPercentage is used in the mul/div arithmetic chain.
The compounding arithmetic produces remainingTokens.
The arithmetic result is stored into totalRewardThisYear.
The arithmetic result yields canExtractThisYear.
block.timestamp flows into the local _time used for reward gating (timestamp dependency).
time() returns now, feeding _time in collectToken (timestamp dependency).
_time is passed to yearFor to derive yearCount (timestamp dependency).
yearFor return value becomes yearCount.
Block timestamp influences the year computed by yearFor (timestamp dependency).
rewardStartTime is the baseline subtracted inside yearFor.
The timestamp parameter is the operand of the subtraction/division in yearFor.
The arithmetic result is returned by yearFor.
rewardStartTime is subtracted from the timestamp in yearFor arithmetic.
msg.sender determines whether collectToken executes (onlyWithdrawer).
msg.sender is stored as withdrawer in the constructor, granting privileged access.
msg.sender is stored as owner in the constructor, granting admin access.
The onlyWithdrawer modifier keyed on withdrawer guards collectToken.
The notPaused modifier keyed on paused gates collectToken.
onlyOwner modifier restricts setWithdrawer to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts setOwner to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts pauseCollectToken to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier restricts resumeCollectToken to the owner.
onlyWithdrawer modifier restricts transferTokens to the withdrawer.
_withdrawer parameter is assigned to the withdrawer state variable.
_owner parameter is assigned to the owner state variable.
pauseCollectToken writes paused = true.
resumeCollectToken writes paused = false.
dst parameter is the recipient of the arbitrary ERC20 external transfer.
wad parameter is the amount of the arbitrary ERC20 external transfer.
_token parameter is cast to ERC20 and used for the external transfer call.
transferTokens controls execution of the external token.transfer call.
Constructor parameter _rewardStartTime initialises rewardStartTime.
Constructor parameter _key initialises the key state variable.
Constructor parameter _withdrawer initialises the privileged withdrawer address.
yearCount bounds the for-loop driven by index i.
Each loop iteration re-executes the reward compounding arithmetic.
collectToken calls yearFor to derive the year index.
collectToken calls time() to obtain the current timestamp.
time() returns now, exposing block.timestamp to all callers (timestamp dependency).
The computed canExtract is accumulated into collectedTokens before the external transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Ephemeral cache of time() only used inside collectToken; fold into the enclosing function.
In-memory gas-saving alias of the key state variable used only within collectToken.
Intermediate token balance value used only inside collectToken.
Intermediate sum (collectedTokens + balance) scoped to collectToken.
Loop-carried intermediate used only in collectToken's reward arithmetic.
Loop-bound value derived and consumed solely within collectToken.
Loop counter with no meaning outside collectToken.
Intermediate accrual value confined to collectToken.
Final computed amount is consumed directly by the external _key.transfer call.
Input parameter of yearFor; belongs to that function's semantics.
Input parameter written to a state variable inside setWithdrawer.
Input parameter written to a state variable inside setOwner.
Input parameter forwarded to the external token transfer inside transferTokens.
Input parameter used as transfer amount inside transferTokens.
Input parameter cast to ERC20 inside transferTokens.
Constructor argument assigned to the key state variable.
Constructor argument assigned to the withdrawer state variable and gating privilege.
